newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Thousands of Indonesians vote in Malaysia.
newsitem.headline: Thousands of Indonesians vote in Malaysia.

text.p: Thousands of Indonesians trooped to polling stations in Malaysia on Thursday to vote in their country's general election, an Indonesian embassy official said.

Labour-short Malaysia is home to 1.4 million eligible Indonesian voters out of a total of two million who have come to the country in search of jobs, Indonesian embassy information attache Achmad Nawawi Hasbi told Reuters.
He said the embassy and its consulates had set up polling stations in the northern island of Penang and in the north Borneo city of Kota Kinabalu, as well as in Kuala Lumpur.
Most voters in Malaysia were expected to vote by post. Some 20,000 ballots have already been received in the mail, he said.
